name: Mai Yome ~My Yome~
source:
"I'm going to become Oniichan's waifu!"

She just loves me and is all excited over our newly wed couple like lifestyle.
Cooking in naked apron, cleaning your back in the bath and sleeping all together!
But, a man can only resist his sexual desires for so long...

"If you are going to be Mai Waifu, you'll need to service me 'here' too..."

Teach your little sister about how to sustain a happy married life!
